items.title: Goldman Sachs puts Kaynes and Syrma in its 42-stock India AI Enablers portfolio
items.text: BusinessToday reported on 1 Oct 2026 that Goldman Sachs pushed back on the 'short AI' India narrative. It listed Kaynes Technology and Syrma SGS among 42 stocks with visible revenue generation, order-book pipelines, capital commitments and partnerships across the AI-related supply chain. The article gives no laminate or PCB specifics, so this is a sentiment signal on the EMS names rather than on the CCL angle.

sources.title: Goldman Sachs pushes back on 'short AI' India narrative, says report; 42 stocks in focus

items.title: Syrma SGS hits record high of Rs 1,809.2, up 7.08% in a day
items.text: Syrma SGS rose 7.08% to an intraday high of Rs 1,809.2 on 30 Sep 2026, a new 52-week and all-time high, against a Sensex gain of 0.34%. MarketsMojo reports the stock is up 145.30% year-to-date and 21.95% over one month, and trades above all major moving averages. The page cites technical momentum and does not link the move to laminates. Syrma's CCL and PCB plans are still pre-revenue, with PCB revenue expected only from FY28, so the move reflects EMS and PCB sentiment more than laminate earnings.

sources.title: Syrma SGS Technology Ltd Surges 7.08% to Day's High of Rs 1809.2

items.title: Shanti Gold buys 2.65 lakh Ratnaveer shares for Rs 8.83 crore in market
items.text: Shanti Gold International bought 2.65 lakh equity shares of Ratnaveer Precision Engineering for Rs 8.83 crore, a weighted average Rs 333.33 per share, giving it about 0.37% of the company. The purchase was a secondary-market transaction. The article calls the stake too small to move the stock or influence governance, but it shows continued investor interest as Ratnaveer builds its CCL plant.

sources.title: Shanti Gold International Acquires 2.65 Lakh Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Shares for ₹8.83 Crore
